profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker SOUN, headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, with CIK 0001840856. According to its website, its OASYS platform powers voice-native AI agents that resolve service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The company describes this technology as agentic AI.

The site also carries customer statements, attributed to unnamed clients, saying that SoundHound's agentic AI lets them resolve more requests faster and scale operations as demand grows, that its voice AI has helped franchisees process orders more efficiently during peak hours, and that its hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity support always-on voice experiences for customers on the go.

Delaware is the jurisdiction associated with 33 legal matters involving the company. No lawsuits are listed against it, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
